beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: In this town, everybody parties.
beats.visual: Crane down the party street.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Except me. I'm the cat.
beats.visual: Window push; inside, the camera finds the cat sitting on a table next to a mug, staring into the lens.

beats.speaker: cat
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: One paw swipe per HUSS: mug, pencil, book, apple, remote, a tiny trophy fly off the table.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The pigeon got a tattoo. It just says Coo.
beats.visual: The pigeon shows off a wing: a tattoo heart that reads COO.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: While they're out partying, by the way, I push things off tables.
beats.visual: Bedroom desk: the cat slowly nudges a glass toward the edge, eye contact with the lens.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: A pen. A phone. A whole lasagna.
beats.visual: Three quick swipes, each object falls on its word; the lasagna lands upside down.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Gravity is just the floor asking nicely. A physicist, crying.

card.quote: Gravity is just the floor asking nicely.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD; attribution on 'A physicist, crying.'

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then came the Summer Party Fancy Dinner.
beats.visual: Square: a long dinner table on the stage with a giant champagne-glass tower in the middle; crowd in bow ties.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Five hundred glasses. One table edge.
beats.visual: Tilt up the tower; on 'edge' the cat hops onto the far end of the table.

beats.speaker: cat
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: The cat steps closer along the table on each HUSS; the crowd gasps.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Everybody froze. Even the DJ.
beats.visual: Music cuts; crowd frozen 'shocked'; DJ Grandad frozen mid-scratch.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Every glass is a floor glass eventually. My mum.

card.quote: Every glass is a floor glass eventually.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD over the cat and the tower; attribution on 'My mum.'

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: So I sat next to it. And did nothing.
beats.visual: The cat sits beside the tower and just stares at the lens. Nothing happens.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Top ten respectful moments. Number seven: I let it live.
beats.visual: TOP 10 card; the crowd claps slowly; the mayor bows to the cat.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then the pigeon landed on it.
beats.visual: The tattooed pigeon flaps down onto the top glass.

beats.speaker: pigeon
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: One tier of the tower collapses per HUSS, from the top down; glasses fly everywhere.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: They banned the pigeon. I got a medal.
beats.visual: BANNED stamp on the pigeon; the mayor hangs a gold medal on the cat.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Never trust a bird with a tattoo. My grandad.

card.quote: Never trust a bird with a tattoo.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD; reveal: Grandad nodding with his own COO tattoo on his arm.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Now in this town, everybody eats off the floor. Except me.
beats.visual: Everyone picnics on the stage floor among glass shards; tables gone. The cat alone on the only table.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I'm still on the table.
beats.visual: The cat on the table, eye contact, slowly reaches a paw toward the camera.

beats.speaker: cat
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Paw taps the camera on each HUSS; on the third the camera tips off the table, the picture spins and falls to black.
